rule: P0/P1 MUST FIX with BEFORE→CHANGE→AFTER→REGRESSION; P2/P3 backlog unless bounded high-ROI

findings.title: Ceremony ledger format schema-invalid and invisible to lib/output-cost
findings.evidence: BEFORE run-case-b.js:96-108 (observedCredits/state, l.totals crash shape); schemas/generation-cost-ledger.schema.json:19; lib/output-cost/budget.js:268-270
findings.impact: mixed formats can turn unknown spend into 0 credits for any lib-side consumer
findings.reproducibility: deterministic — case-ledger validate on the Task-01 file
findings.rootCause: three copy-pasted ledger helpers with legacy field names, no shared owner
findings.recommendedAction: single canonical owner with canonical names + legacy-tolerant reader
findings.fix: scripts/cli/case-ledger.js (normalizeEntry, computeTotals, appendLedger, validateLedger); CLIs delegate; regression tests/cost/test-hardening-budget-gates.js (A-1/A-2)

findings.title: Live ledger hand-edited outside code paths; stale top-level totals
findings.evidence: BEFORE header creditsObserved=43 vs totals.creditsObserved=50 (evidence/before-after/BEFORE-ledger.json.bak + BEFORE-ledger-validate.json: STALE_HEADER)
findings.impact: canonical spend state mutated outside auditable code; two contradicting totals in one file
findings.rootCause: hand edit changed the flat header without recompute and without audit trail
findings.recommendedAction: explicit reconcile subcommand through one code path; preserve previous header
findings.fix: case-ledger reconcile (header 43→50, previousHeader preserved with reason + timestamp); Task-01 bytes preserved under evidence/before-after

findings.title: Retry reservation silently dropped on attemptId ledger collision; C/D never append reservation
findings.evidence: BEFORE run-case-b.js:99 dedupe by attemptId; repair :319-322 same attemptId; run-case-c/d no reservation append (BEFORE-*.bak)
findings.impact: remainingBudget overstated during in-flight retry
findings.reproducibility: deterministic — second append with same attemptId dropped
findings.rootCause: dedupe keyed by attemptId only; C/D repair paths lacked reservation symmetry
findings.fix: (attemptId, kind) dedupe key in case-ledger; kind=reservation/reconciliation on all appends; C/D repair paths append reservations like B
findings.after: test A-3 (reservation + reconciliation coexist; same-kind idempotent) PASS

findings.title: Unknown submit state contributes 0 to remaining budget
findings.impact: gate could see full budget while an unknown-cost submit is in flight
findings.fix: unknownSpendCount + REVIEW_REQUIRED_UNKNOWN_SPEND in authorizeGenerationAttempt and authorizeRetry; ceremony wrappers normalize entries so lib sees in-flight spend
findings.after: tests/cost/test-hardening-budget-gates.js A-10 (attempt + retry blocked; clean-ledger control APPROVED) PASS

findings.title: applyManualOverride left stale derived properties (downgrade keeps VIDEO caps; upgrade keeps referenceStrategy NONE)
findings.evidence: index.js:92-131 re-derivation block; validator judges effectiveOutputType
findings.impact: overridden decisions validation-invalid or silently losing identity guidance (the VEO_REFERENCE downgrade class)
findings.rootCause: derived capability/role/strategy fields carried over from the recommendation
findings.fix: re-derive referenceStrategy/requiredCapabilities/requiredAssetRoles from the SELECTED strategy + continuity signals; renderMode re-resolved with identityCritical kept
findings.after: tests/story/test-visual-motion-decision.js H-OV1/H-OV2/H-OV3 PASS (150 assertions, full story domain PASS)

findings.title: persistDecision selection-restore kept new renderMode with old effectiveOutputType
findings.impact: persisted artifact not renderer-reproducible from structured fields
findings.rootCause: incompatible merge of old selection over recomputed recommendation
findings.fix: refuse the incompatible merge; caller re-runs decide + override

findings.title: applyModelOverride did not recompute cost; units ignored effectiveModel
findings.impact: budget priced for the recommended model after operator override
findings.fix: units resolve the EFFECTIVE model; full providers + cost domains PASS (152 + 161 assertions)

findings.title: registerAsset never persisted asset bytes (canonical media not core-owned)
findings.evidence: registry.js:127-159 A-8 block: managed persistence via writeArtifactAtomic when relativePath absent
findings.impact: assetId lineage dangled if downloads/ cleaned
findings.rootCause: bytes held only by the caller; record kept metadata + hash only
findings.fix: persist bytes under assets/<type>/<assetId>.<ext> through the atomic store; flow/test-asset-library.js 41 assertions PASS

findings.title: Case D cross-shot QA + finalize PASS-by-construction; B5/B6/D6 hardcoded
findings.evidence: BEFORE matrices (B5/B6, C1/C2/C6/C8/C14, D1/D2/D6/D15/D17/D18 hardcoded PASS — BEFORE-*.bak)
findings.impact: continuity/correlation evidence could not block a READY verdict
findings.reproducibility: deterministic — code inspection of BEFORE matrices
findings.rootCause: matrix rows asserted by comment instead of computed from records
findings.fix: lib/real-e2e/correlation.js checkCorrelationForReady (ambiguity/sha-mismatch never READY); all flagged rows computed (source gate, correlation gate, lineage, hash-count dedup, ledger state)
findings.after: tests/real-e2e/test-correlation-gate.js (6) PASS; full real-e2e domain PASS

findings.title: Regression gaps: override-preserves-VEO_REFERENCE; correlation-ambiguity-cannot-become-READY; remainingBudget-unknown
findings.evidence: H-OV1..OV4 pre-existed; other two had no tests
findings.impact: fixes not pinned
findings.rootCause: tests written for features, not for the hardening properties
findings.fix: test-correlation-gate.js + test-hardening-budget-gates.js added (H-OV* already pinned override)
findings.after: new suites PASS; full regression 0 failed

findings.title: Ceremony wjson bypasses atomic artifact store
findings.impact: crash can leave truncated JSON
findings.recommendedAction: route through writeArtifactAtomic

findings.title: Correlation submitAtApprox hardcoded; D_SUBMIT_EVIDENCE events emitted only by hand
findings.impact: stale submit time reproduced for new attempts
findings.recommendedAction: read from ceremony log / explicit arg; emit events in code

findings.title: Declared video dimension expectation silently NOT_APPLICABLE when unobservable
findings.impact: dimension mismatch can be missed on videos
findings.recommendedAction: UNKNOWN/BLOCKER when expectation declared but unobservable

findings.title: compileForDecision compiled every package twice
findings.impact: efficiency + validated-vs-persisted skew
findings.recommendedAction: compile once, persist the validated result
findings.fix: persist p.result instead of recompiling; story domain PASS

findings.title: Generation-unit/correlation identity gaps (no attemptId/promptVersion/referenceIds/instructionsVersion on units; attempt ids break at >=10)
findings.impact: identity fragmented across artifacts
findings.recommendedAction: extend unit + correlation record fields (bridge submit-issued covers the live path)

findings.title: Dead ternary + spurious UNKNOWNs for absent expectations
findings.impact: inflated unknownLayers
findings.recommendedAction: fix ternary; NOT_APPLICABLE for absent expectations

findings.title: Aggregate recommendation ignores WARNING-severity failures
findings.impact: review-required asset gets NONE recommendation
findings.recommendedAction: inspect warningLayers too

findings.title: Reserved + observed double-count on entries carrying both
findings.impact: conservative overblock
findings.recommendedAction: document semantics; release on reconcile

findings.title: Unlock→mutate→lock idempotency loop destroys lock history
findings.impact: lock provenance lost on re-run; transient unlock window
findings.recommendedAction: no-op when already locked with same reason

findings.title: Structural input precedence: bytes vs filePath can diverge silently
findings.impact: mixed-evidence QA if caller passes stale bytes
findings.recommendedAction: document; prefer probe consistently

findings.title: No provenance gate on canonical source selection (avatar as-1186233d1af6 stayed SELECTED+locked while REJECTED)
findings.evidence: BEFORE-avatar-record.json (SELECTED + locked + REJECTED + source existing/provider null); §5.1 acceptance violated in data
findings.impact: false canonical generation asset silently passes reference selection
findings.reproducibility: deterministic — gate on the BEFORE record refuses; live index record migrated
findings.rootCause: setSelection validates enum only; no provenance/QA/lineage requirement for source use
findings.fix: validateCanonicalSource (type + QA-APPROVED + generation lineage); wired into B/C/D source rows (B1/C1/C2/D1); explicit migration of as-1186233d1af6 to REJECTED+locked with reason trail

findings.title: Approval gate state in-memory only, dies with service worker
findings.impact: worker reaped between APPROVE_RECORD and SUBMIT_GENERATE → false APPROVAL_REQUIRED (fail-safe: blocks, never duplicates)
findings.recommendedAction: persist approval to chrome.storage.session; lazy rehydrate

findings.title: sidepanel bridgeCall had no timeout
findings.impact: hung loopback server → dead silent wait on credit path (Q17 surface)
findings.recommendedAction: AbortController+timeout

findings.title: render() rewrote jobCard.innerHTML every cycle, destroying keyboard focus
findings.impact: focus dropped to body ~every 5s for up to 10 min; DOM churn
findings.recommendedAction: skip re-render when signature unchanged
findings.after: a11y gate: no focus trap; distinct controls visited; full e2e PASS

findings.title: GENERATING poll gave no feedback when Flow tab disappears
findings.evidence: sidepanel.js:825-837 unreachableStreak>=3 → NEED_FLOW + toast (working-tree fix, verified)
findings.impact: busy CTA 10 min with no message despite diagnosable FLOW_TAB_NOT_FOUND
findings.recommendedAction: surface friendly error + NEED_FLOW after N unreachable polls
findings.after: code-verified; live-tab-disappearance covered by offline e2e step 6 pattern

findings.title: Status chip had no aria-live for state changes
findings.impact: screen readers missed GENERATING/READY transitions
findings.recommendedAction: aria-live=polite on status text

findings.title: link-btn/toast-close below WCAG 2.5.8 24px target size
findings.impact: small hit areas
findings.recommendedAction: min 24x24 + padding

findings.title: BLOCKED CTA silently enables Developer Mode (persisted)
findings.impact: normal user switched to dev persona without notice
findings.recommendedAction: human error card only; explicit opt-in

findings.title: Small unbounded buffers (log pre, AWAIT_BASELINES/acceptancePolls Maps)
findings.impact: minor memory growth per session
findings.recommendedAction: cap log; prune Maps on acceptance

findings.title: Dead listener DIAGNOSTICS_UPDATE (never sent)
findings.impact: dead code implying nonexistent channel
findings.recommendedAction: remove

findings.title: Token auto-recovery fires mid-typing
findings.impact: 401 churn + toast noise during paste
findings.recommendedAction: debounce on silence + min length

findings.title: Raw error code shown in toast on approval/generation failure
findings.impact: normal mode sees raw code
findings.recommendedAction: body in toast, codes in details card

findings.title: Credit-gate helpers exported but untested
findings.evidence: extension suite 533 assertions incl. 8 TI consumeLocalApproval tests (working-tree fix, verified PASS)
findings.impact: most credit-sensitive extension logic untested (was Q15/Q16 evidence gap)
findings.recommendedAction: TI group: replay/attempt/nonce/fingerprint/both-absent

findings.title: Credentialed fetch of message-supplied URL without origin constraint
findings.impact: defense-in-depth: content-script compromise could exfiltrate via credentialed fetch
findings.recommendedAction: constrain msg.url to captured result-candidate origins / google-owned https hosts
findings.rationale: P3; token gate + loopback + sender pinning (C-6) + 60MB cap contain the path; host-constrain risks breaking legit result hosts without a measured allowlist — needs operator-session traffic sample first

findings.title: Artifact transport cap (256KB) contradicted the 60MB artifact limit
findings.evidence: server.js per-route cap ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES*4/3 + slack; Buffer-safe readBody; PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE→400 (working-tree fix, verified diff)
findings.impact: panel-driven import unreachable for real Flow outputs
findings.rootCause: single 256KB cap applied to the base64 artifact body; string-chunk concat

findings.title: Lost ACK after provider-accepted submit could produce a second generation
findings.evidence: markSubmitIssued + AWAITING_PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE + DUPLICATE_APPROVAL + APPROVAL_NONCE_MISMATCH (working-tree fix, verified diff)
findings.impact: duplicate credit spend possible
findings.rootCause: no durable submit-issued record; approval overwrite; volatile worker map
findings.after: H1–H4 PASS; safety-retry 34 assertions PASS; DUPLICATE_PAID_SUBMIT_COUNT=0

findings.title: No distinct provider-execution ACK states
findings.impact: missed acceptance signal left stale state re-submittable
findings.recommendedAction: dedicated acceptance state
findings.after: H8 verifies RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED exit; state-machine 15 assertions PASS

findings.title: job-store read-modify-write unsynchronized
findings.evidence: atomicity note in job-store.js (verified: all mutator bodies fully synchronous, no await)
findings.impact: theoretical lost-update
findings.recommendedAction: serialize mutations

findings.title: Bridge recorded approvals without settings-tuple fingerprint binding
findings.impact: durable layer could not distinguish exact-tuple approval
findings.recommendedAction: require fingerprint with nonce; bind nonce at generate

findings.title: Origin allowlists treated every chrome-extension:// origin as trusted
findings.evidence: service-worker.js:26-34 + sender-check.js:11-21 pin chrome.runtime.id (working-tree fix, verified)
findings.impact: co-installed malicious extension could drive the command surface
findings.recommendedAction: pin chrome.runtime.id; bridge keeps token gate
findings.after: extension TI validateSender rejects foreign senders (533 suite PASS)

findings.title: Side-panel bridgeCall had no timeout (duplicate of B-2)
findings.recommendedAction: AbortController timeout

findings.title: POST /jobs never validated the flow-job contract
findings.evidence: server validates via contracts/job-contract.js before persisting (working-tree fix)
findings.impact: missing requestId failed only at import time (late)
findings.recommendedAction: checkJobShape in createJob; reject SCHEMA_INVALID

findings.title: Wire messages carry no contractVersion/correlationId
findings.impact: stale build not rejected; no cross-layer correlation id
findings.recommendedAction: stamp commands with {contractVersion, jobId, attempt, correlationId}
findings.rationale: submit-issued + approval-nonce binding covers the credit path; full wire versioning is 1H manifest work (Q20 notes structured outputs as 1H input)

findings.title: Cancellation does not propagate after result detection
findings.impact: panel keeps polling a cancelled job
findings.recommendedAction: RESULT_DETECTED→CANCELLED + per-poll status check

findings.title: Unbounded in-memory maps in content script
findings.impact: page-lifetime leak, few entries per job
findings.recommendedAction: evict on acceptance

findings.title: Acceptance-baseline recapture after tab refresh can make accepted submit unobservable
findings.impact: SUBMIT_NOT_ACCEPTED while Flow generates
findings.recommendedAction: treat submitIssuedAt + new candidates as acceptance evidence

findings.title: readBody concatenated Buffer chunks as strings (UTF-8 boundary corruption)
findings.impact: JSON corruption on multi-byte split
findings.recommendedAction: Buffer.concat
